about: Planning presets, not legal advice. Each preset holds the few numeric limits a flight plan can be compared against. Rules differ by country, airspace class, category of operation and authorisation; the operator is responsible for knowing the ones that apply. `vlos_advisory_m` is a planning threshold for visual line of sight, not a legal distance.

rule_sets.label: Generic: 120 m above ground, visual line of sight
rule_sets.notes: The height limit most national rules share for operations without a specific authorisation.

rule_sets.label: EU / EASA Open category
rule_sets.notes: Open category: within 120 m of the closest point of the surface, in visual line of sight, under 25 kg. Subcategory, class marking and UAS geographical zones are not evaluated here.

rule_sets.label: USA / FAA Part 107
rule_sets.notes: 400 ft above ground level (higher only within 400 ft of a structure), 100 mph groundspeed, under 55 lb, visual line of sight. Airspace authorisation (LAANC) is not evaluated here.

rule_sets.label: Custom limits (specific authorisation)
rule_sets.notes: No preset limits: enter the limits of your authorisation in the plan.
